review_result.finding: The artifact uses a non-colliding Get-TargetVm wrapper with an explicitly module-qualified Hyper-V\Get-VM call, uses documented graceful Stop-VM syntax, retries the documented explicit-credential PowerShell Direct session form every five seconds for at most ten minutes while the guest finishes booting, enumerates clean-shell before VM start, queries only recorded VM hard-disk paths with Get-DiskImage -ImagePath, requires the isolated guest .wslconfig to remain absent, and refuses to overwrite controlled-package-baseline. Post-reboot observations show substantially more ordinary free and commit capacity, but do not prove Hyper-V allocatable capacity; execution remains the fail-closed test and requires fresh approval of the exact r8 hash.
